attributes.during:
Display the ship Wormwood next to a random location. Before you would encounter a monster with the Pirate trait, move the Wormwood to your location and encounter it; then encounter the bane. 
At the start of each turn, examine the top card of the location deck next to the Wormwood; if it is a boon, banish it. Then shuffle the location deck.
